title: artemisia dracunculus subsp. glauca
intro: Artemisia dracunculus subsp. glauca, commonly known as Wild Tarragon, is a perennial herb native to Central Asia and Eastern Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Tarragon include its use as a carminative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular choice for addressing gastrointestinal issues and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of Wild Tarragon include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
